build_d4pg_learner: build a D4PG learner with Adam optimizer and optional gradient clipping for policy and critic networks
build_replay_tables: build Reverb replay tables with uniform sampling and configurable rate limiter for D4PG training
build_dataset_iterator: build a multi-device dataset iterator from Reverb replay client with n-step trajectory postprocessing
build_d4pg_adder: build a structured adder to record actor-environment transitions into the Reverb replay buffer
build_d4pg_actor: build a CPU-based GenericActor with variable client for D4PG policy inference and data collection
